Name: Calico Jack Overhaul
Author: marcoantonio6
Description:
Tired of Calico Jack or find it too confusing? This mod completely replaces it with a real Blackjack minigame, created from scratch with real casino rules.

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Replaces the Calico Jack minigame with a fully featured Blackjack experience — split hands, configurable dealer rules, multiple deck sizes, and flexible shuffle options.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[*][b]American and European dealer styles[/b] — American deals a face-down hole card and checks for Blackjack immediately; European deals only one visible card at the start.[/*]
[*][b]Dealer hit rule[/b] — choose between S17 (dealer stands on all 17s) or H17 (dealer hits on soft 17).[/*]
[*][b]Split hands[/b] — split any pair, including Aces. Configurable limits for normal pairs (0–4 splits) and Ace pairs (0–4 splits) independently.[/*]
[*][b]Blackjack detection[/b] — natural 21 on the opening deal triggers an animated reveal sequence with the correct sound and payout.[/*]
[*][b]Deck size[/b] — choose from 1, 2, 4, 6, or 8 decks. American style defaults to 6 decks, European to 2, or set a custom size manually.[/*]
[*][b]Shuffle rules[/b] — shuffle every round, only after 50% of the shoe is used, or never (until the deck runs out).

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]: for you to configure as you wish.

[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
This is my first mod, it may contain some bugs and if I find any I will rush to fix them. I made it with a lot of care and thank you very much for downloading.[/*]
